Because he embalmed his father, or because of the ALMOST FIVE times he heard 'your servant my father' and kept silent - the count this corpus machine-verified two groups ago as four identical seats and a fifth carrying prefixed prepositions. THE CONTRAST WORD IS A ONE-OFF, AND THE MACHINE CONFIRMS IT [claim G73-21, machine-checked]. Mourning that PASSED here against mourning that CONCLUDED for Moses - read as company: he had no others weeping, so his mourning simply ended; this man had others, so the days passed. ALE u-qevor et avikha KA-ASHER HISHBIEKHA — 'go up and bury your father AS HE MADE YOU SWEAR': the king grants by citing the oath itself (the kaf of the swear-word soft, asserted under G73-11) — the machine notes the mechanism: the demand the machine recorded at 47:31 (hishava li — sworn in place) is the legal tender that opens the border; the pop lands in the king's one verse.

A MASTER REPORTS FINDING NO SUCH PLACE, AND OUR CORPUS AGREES ON ITS OWN LEG [claim G73-22, machine-checked]. Is there a threshing floor for a bramble? He searched all Scripture and found no place of that name, and concluded these were the Canaanites, fit to be trampled like brambles. Machine-checked on the Torah: the name stands at exactly TWO tokens in the entire corpus, both in this one scene. …

THE TITLE IS CHALLENGED AT THE GRAVESIDE AND ANSWERED WITH A DOCUMENT. When the burial was contested, Naphtali RAN LIKE A DOE to Egypt and brought back THE DEED - the exhibit read at the previous block whose scene is this verse. The plot's price stands twice-paid in this corpus: the field bought from the sons of Chet, and the brother's share bought out at the estate. [folded shape: kept record]

Restraint grounded in piety rather than in incapacity - and at the hinge of the reconciliation the declared reading is not saying one thing. Recorded as which is which, not resolved. Read as words that settle it, and itemized: you were likened to the DUST, the BEASTS and the STARS - can anyone eliminate these? shall I change the world's order and eliminate twelve tribes, who answer to the twelve hours and the twelve constellations?
